mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month change) and the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the real economy, reducing corporate investment and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (3-month change) and the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (YoY), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) signals rising consumer leverage and spending, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises (3-month change) and the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) for two consecutive months signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate investment and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines (3-month change), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 500.0 (thousands of units) for two consecutive months signals a strong housing market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 500.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
